mainEntity.name: How do you calculate exact age?

acceptedAnswer.text: Subtract the birth date from the target date year, month and day. If the day difference is negative, borrow the number of days in the previous month and reduce the month count by one. Do the same for months and years.

mainEntity.name: How does the calculator handle leap years?

acceptedAnswer.text: It uses the real calendar, so 29 February is included in leap years and total days are exact. A year is a leap year if divisible by 4, except century years that are not divisible by 400.
It is the date 10,000 days after you were born, which falls at about 27 years and 4 months old. The tool also shows when you reach 20,000 days and one billion seconds.

mainEntity.name: What does the life progress bar mean?

acceptedAnswer.text: It shows your age as a share of an average life expectancy, which you can edit. It is a statistical average for a group, not a forecast for any one person.

mainEntity.name: Is my date of birth stored?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Everything is calculated in your browser and nothing is sent to a server. The share link only puts your dates in the web address you copy.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between Western and Korean age?

acceptedAnswer.text: Western (international) age counts completed years from the birth date. Traditional Korean age starts at 1 and adds a year every 1 January, so it is one or two years higher. South Korea adopted international age for most legal and administrative uses on 28 June 2023.

mainEntity.name: How do I find the age difference between two people?

acceptedAnswer.text: Subtract the older birth date from the younger one, borrowing days from the previous month when needed. For example, 3 September 1992 and 14 May 1995 differ by 2 years, 8 months and 11 days (983 days).

mainEntity.name: Why do age calculators sometimes show different days?

acceptedAnswer.text: They borrow days from different months when the day count is negative. This calculator borrows the length of the previous month and uses the real calendar, so total days are exact either way.

mainEntity.name: How old am I if I was born on 29 February?

acceptedAnswer.text: In leap years you have a birthday on 29 February. In other years the legal date is 28 February or 1 March depending on local law, and this tool shows 1 March.

mainEntity.name: How do I calculate age in Excel or Google Sheets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use DATEDIF with the birth date and TODAY(): "Y" gives completed years, "YM" the remaining months and "MD" the remaining days.
